name: ANAIS-112
summary: ANAIS-112 is the University of Zaragoza's same-target annual-modulation test at Canfranc, using NaI(Tl) to compare with DAMA/LIBRA while reducing target-material model dependence.
detection_principle: Stable long-term ultralow-background NaI spectra are recorded. Annual-modulation amplitudes are fitted with controlled thresholds, efficiencies and background models.

results.summary: Six years of data show no modulation expected from DAMA and provide a same-target test of its interpretation.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
